comment: Grimmjow Gran Rey Cero beam segment, 96x64, tiles seamlessly left-right (every ripple/spiral is periodic over 96 px; verified by tiling the export). Cel bands: deep blue rippling rim (to ~cy+-27), cyan body (+-20), pale cyan (+-12), white-hot core (+-5); a white-cyan double helix wraps the beam (back half hidden behind it) and flows right 96 px per loop with streak sparks. ORIGIN = left middle (0,32). Hit half-height 20 (cyan body); the glow rim reaches ~27. Draw it tiled from the start point along the beam's length; mirror for left.

Gran Rey Cero tip / impact: the beam's bands (same profile as gran_rey_cero) run in from the left edge into a big round cero burst centred at (58,56): white core r14, pale cyan r23, cyan r31, blue r36, blue spikes to r50 slowly turning, a white shockwave ring expanding r32->52 each loop and spark streaks. ORIGIN = (0,56), the left middle where the segment ends (place it at the segment's end point). Hit circle: centre (58,56), radius 32.

Ulquiorra Cero Oscuras beam segment, 96x64, tiles seamlessly left-right (all ripples/strands periodic over 96 px, lightning drawn as whole-tile periodic copies; verified by tiling). Cel bands: dark-teal haze rim (to ~cy+-25), teal-green glowing rim (+-17) with a pale mint inner edge line, pitch-black core (+-11) with faint dark-teal vein strands; thin black lightning bolts (teal-tipped) crackle across the rims, one or two per frame. ORIGIN = left middle (0,32). Hit half-height 17 (teal rim); the haze reaches ~25. Draw tiled from the start point along the beam; mirror for left.

Cero Oscuras tip / impact: the segment's bands (same profile as cero_oscuras) run in from the left edge into a black cero orb centred at (58,56): black core r22 with a slowly turning dark-teal 3-arm swirl, pale mint r25, teal r30, dark-teal haze r35 with spikes to ~r50, black lightning bolts arcing out of the orb, a mint shockwave ring expanding r30->52 each loop and spark streaks. ORIGIN = (0,56), the left middle where the segment ends (place it at the segment's end point). Hit circle: centre (58,56), radius 30.

Ichigo Vasto Lorde cero beam segment, 96x64, tiles seamlessly left-right (all ripples periodic over 96 px; verified by tiling). Cel bands: dark red ragged rim (to ~cy+-25), crimson body (+-16), bright red (+-8), a black core streak (+-3.5) that snakes along the axis edged by a thin pale-pink glow line; dark flecks stream right through the body and pale sparks along the rim. ORIGIN = left middle (0,32). Hit half-height 16 (crimson body); the dark rim reaches ~25. Draw tiled from the start point; mirror for left.

Vasto Lorde cero tip / impact: the segment's bands (same profile as vasto_cero) run in from the left edge into a red cero orb centred at (58,56): black centre r10 rimmed pale pink r14, bright red r22, crimson r30, dark red r35 with dark red spikes to ~r50 slowly turning, a pale shockwave ring expanding r31->52 each loop, spark and dark fleck bursts. ORIGIN = (0,56), the left middle where the segment ends (place it at the segment's end point). Hit circle: centre (58,56), radius 30.

Link's Dragon of Light beam segment, 96x64, tiles seamlessly left-right (ripples and scale rows periodic over 96 px; verified by tiling). Smooth cel bands: amber-gold glow rim (to ~cy+-23), gold body (+-16), pale gold (+-10), white core (+-5); four rows of small overlapping dragon-scale arcs (faint, one shade off their band) drift right 24 px per loop; white sparkles twinkle along both rims and fast white streaks run along the core. ORIGIN = left middle (0,32). Hit half-height 16 (gold body). Draw tiled from the start point; mirror for left.

Dragon of Light tip / impact: the segment's bands and scale rows (same profile as light_dragon) run in from the left edge into a radiant holy orb centred at (58,56): white core r11, pale gold r20, gold r28, amber r33 with 16 thin gold light spikes slowly turning, a white 4-point star glint (pulsing 30-40 px arms) on the orb, a white halo ring expanding r30->52 each loop and sparkle bursts. ORIGIN = (0,56), the left middle where the segment ends (place it at the segment's end point). Hit circle: centre (58,56), radius 30.

Ganondorf demon dragon gloom breath segment, 96x64, tiles seamlessly left-right (ripples, veins and wisps periodic over 96 px; verified by tiling). Cel bands: near-black maroon ragged gloom edge (to ~cy+-26), dark red body (+-17), a thin crimson glow line (+-13.5) around a black core (+-12); three glowing crimson veins (two bright, one dark red, irregular double-harmonic curves) writhe through the black core and flow right; dark maroon wisps trail off both edges, crimson embers drift along the body. ORIGIN = left middle (0,32). Hit half-height 17 (dark red body); the gloom edge reaches ~26. Draw tiled from the start point; mirror for left.

Demon dragon breath tip / impact: the segment's bands (same profile as demon_dragon) run in from the left edge into a black gloom orb centred at (58,56): black core r22 holding a turning vortex of crimson veins (5-arm bright + 3-arm dark-red spirals), crimson glow line r24, dark red r30, maroon r35 with ragged maroon/dark red spikes to ~r50, a crimson shockwave ring expanding r30->52 each loop, dark wisp puffs and crimson embers bursting out. ORIGIN = (0,56), the left middle where the segment ends (place it at the segment's end point). Hit circle: centre (58,56), radius 30.
